visual_identity.core_identity: A huge web-building spider with a clear two-part arachnid body, eight long legs, and an ambush posture.
visual_identity.silhouette: Large rounded abdomen behind a smaller cephalothorax, eight long jointed legs radiating outward in a stable hunting or web-building posture.
visual_identity.head_features: Arachnid cephalothorax with multiple simple eyes and visible fangs, no humanoid face.
visual_identity.body_shape: Two main body sections with eight legs attached to the front section; abdomen elevated slightly.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse short hairs and simple abdominal markings; web lines kept broad and readable.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw exactly eight spider legs attached to the cephalothorax, a clear two-part arachnid body, and a stable web-supported posture; keep web strands sparse enough that stone architecture and broad coloring spaces remain visible.

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: A huge web-building spider with a clear two-part arachnid body, eight long legs, and an ambush posture. Two main body sections with eight legs attached to the front section; abdomen elevated slightly. Sparse short hairs and simple abdominal markings; web lines kept broad and readable.
